basic_info.description: Welcome to this delightful 2-bedroom, 1-bath home nestled in the highly sought-after Sunnyside neighborhood. Boasting beautiful city views and boundless potential, this cozy residence offers approximately 889 sq. ft. of living space, making it an excellent opportunity for first-time homebuyers or savvy investors.  Freshly repainted inside and out, this home is a blank canvas, ready for your creative touchwhether through a thoughtful remodel or expansion. Ideally situated, it provides easy access to parks, schools, shops, and public transportation, along with quick highway access for seamless commuting.  Whether you're looking to customize your dream home or make a smart investment in a thriving neighborhood, 134 Detroit Street offers a rare chance to blend character, convenience, and potential in one remarkable property. Don't miss this opportunity!
